QUOTE: "Deny is the last gate. It is checked in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval. `check_approval` only consults the allow list."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in ServerManager::execute, but it also describes other gates (pre-tool hook, schema, MCP authorization, tier checks, approval) that can block, so it doesn't conclude that deny is the only blocking list with execute consulting only is_denied.
